additionalDocuments.label: Wasl One B Tower · original brochure drawings

review.imagery: Twenty-six distinct project renders were visually reviewed. The original 4000-pixel brochure tower view supplies the card and hero. Nineteen current official-gallery views include living, bedrooms, facade, gyms, lobby and multipurpose spaces. Six additional native brochure images cover pool, playroom, duplex interiors, kitchen and resto cafe. The repeated current gym, generic AI-named amenity icons, background textures and accidentally shared plan resources are excluded. Different publishing versions are identified. No card badges.
review.floorPlans: The 51 complete sheets distinguish the separate plan pack from the brochure. Their layouts, dimensions and totals differ, and revision order is unverified. Whole duplex totals apply once. E2 prints an incompatible 805.1 sq ft balcony. Floorplate arithmetic and one brochure floor heading also conflict. Figures remain source-specific. Confirm the approved contractual drawing with Wasl. All 28 individual source sheets were visually reviewed, including every visible numerical panel. Physical plan-pack page 7 is pixel-identical to page 6 and omitted from duplicate choices. All 24 floorplates were reviewed for source level/building scope. The plan-pack floorplates use square metres while brochure counterparts use square feet, without implicit conversion. Brochure page 44 prints level 39 among a conflicting typical-floor heading. Complete source pages, branding and notices are preserved.
review.location: Original brochure page 6 was visually reviewed. One B Tower is explicitly marked on the regional map and all six estimates retain their particular scope. No verified visitor-entrance coordinate is inferred from a sales office or neighbouring Wasl Tower. Project-name directions remain available.
review.provenance: Primary HTML, original CDN brochure and plan PDFs, source hashes, fetch receipts, native brochure image resources and current-gallery source URLs/dimensions are retained. Original protected identities, completed text research and commercial/source qualifications remain intact.

unavailable: A verified residential visitor entrance, dated construction photographs and approved revision order were not established. Five-bedroom and penthouse individual layouts remain unavailable in the reviewed packs. Published area, floorplate-arithmetic and level-heading conflicts remain qualified.
